title: Holidays
content: I apologize for formatting, I am on my cell phone. I am new to the sub, however I have been dreaming about The mall world for nearly 40 years. I’m still trying to process everything, especially the fact that I’m not the only one who has been there and had these dreams. I was wondering if anyone else has experienced any of the holidays that take place in Mall World? There are three distinct holidays that I have experienced over the years. Since I had started dreaming about mall world when I was so young, it wasn’t until I was older that realized these weren’t real holidays. The first holiday, that I recall would take place in the winter time. It was my favorite holiday. We didn’t have a name for it, but it involved floats, which had glowing lights on the back of them that would make up images like animals or toys. It was very similar to Christmas lights, however, it looked a lot more like a drone show, though this was long before drones were a thing. The floats would drive down the road and people would stand outside in their yard and just watch the light lights pass by. I loved this holiday so much that I kept asking my parents when it was going to take place again. When they told me they had no idea what I was talking about. That’s when I realized it was a dream. The second holiday was in the Spring or Summer and was simply a day when planes would fly over and drop toys that would randomly land around town. Kids would go and pick them up. The toys were not anything overly special but it was really fun to watch them fall from the sky and chase them down. I remember one year I got a Sesame Street bath sponge set. Most of the things that were thrown from the planes were stuffed animals. The third holiday was kind of a mix between Easter and Halloween. Kids would get wagons and buckets or bags and travel around the neighborhood collecting elaborately decorated eggs. This is my least favorite of the holidays because the streets would become really really dirty by the end of the night. They would be covered and broken eggs. There really wasn’t anything to do with the eggs once you got them they were pretty, but overall they were just eggs. I think we were supposed to bring them home and cook them, but I really didn’t like eggs as a kid. Anyways, I’m just curious if anyone else had experienced anything like this. I used to dream about Mall World almost every night, but now I only dream about it once or twice a year.
